description: This file defines a static class 'ImageHelper' within the 'MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel' namespace. The class provides utility methods for handling image file paths, including searching for images in subfolders, checking existence, and extracting page numbers from file paths with embedded page references.

classes.name: ImageHelper
classes.description: A static utility class for managing image file paths, existence checks, and extracting page numbers from file paths.

methods.name: GetImageName
methods.description: Returns the first existing image filename from specified subfolders within a root directory.

methods.name: InSubfolder
methods.description: Checks if a given filename exists within the specified subfolders and matches a reference filename.

methods.name: ExtractPageNumber
methods.description: Extracts a page number from a file path if it has a '#<number>' suffix, returning the cleaned path and the page number.
